	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1845.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1845 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1845 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1844.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1844 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1844 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1843.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1843 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1843 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1842.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1842 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1842 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1841.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1841 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1841 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1840.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1840 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1840 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1839.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1839 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1839 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1838.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1838 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1838 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= 1837.1.1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1837 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1837 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = dsm_today_year value = 1836 } dsm_compute_doy = { Y = 1836 } }
	set_variable = { name = dsm_today value = var:dsm_today_year }
	change_variable = { name = dsm_today subtract = 1836 }
	change_variable = { name = dsm_today multiply = 365 }
	change_variable = { name = dsm_today add = var:dsm_today_doy }
}

	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.13 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 13 DOY = 12 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.12 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 12 DOY = 11 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.11 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 11 DOY = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.10 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 10 DOY = 9 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.9 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 9 DOY = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.8 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 8 DOY = 7 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.7 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 7 DOY = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.6 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 6 DOY = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.5 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 5 DOY = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.4 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 4 DOY = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.3 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 3 DOY = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { game_date >= $Y$.1.2 } dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 2 DOY = 1 } }
	else = { dsm_set_today_md = { M = 1 D = 1 DOY = 0 } }
}

dsm_set_today_md = {
	set_variable = { name = dsm_today_month value = $M$ }
	set_variable = { name = dsm_today_day value = $D$ }
	set_variable = { name = dsm_today_doy value = $DOY$ }
}

# Sets dsm_t_mlen (length of month dsm_t_month) and dsm_t_mcum
# (days in the year before that month).
dsm_compute_target_month_info = {
	if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 12 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 334 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 11 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 30 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 304 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 10 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 273 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 9 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 30 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 243 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 8 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 212 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 7 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 181 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 6 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 30 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 151 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 5 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 120 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 4 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 30 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 90 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 3 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 59 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_month = 2 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 28 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 31 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mlen value = 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_mcum value = 0 } }
}

# Converts dsm_t_doy (0..364) into dsm_t_month / dsm_t_day.
dsm_doy_to_target_md = {
	if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 334 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 12 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -333 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 304 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 11 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -303 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 273 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 10 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -272 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 243 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 9 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -242 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 212 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 8 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -211 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 181 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 7 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -180 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 151 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 6 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -150 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 120 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 5 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -119 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 90 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 4 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -89 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 59 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 3 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -58 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:dsm_t_doy >= 31 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 2 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = -30 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = dsm_t_month value = 1 } set_variable = { name = dsm_t_day value = var:dsm_t_doy } change_variable = { name = dsm_t_day add = 1 } }
}
